responses.text: {Small Fry} I must say, fortune seems to be with you of late. Please, enjoy this, compliments of the White Glove Society.
{Big Winner} You certainly seem to be making a splash with all your success in the casino. Our executive chef prepared this delicacy for you himself. Enjoy.
{Whale} You are quite simply the talk of the casino right now with your astonishing play. Do stay in our {BONE veev-ONT, light French 'n' for Bon} Bon Vivant suite so you may continue to dazzle us.
{Banned} This simply will not do. You must leave immediately.
For a while, you were the toast of the Ultra-Luxe, but you're simply not en vogue any longer. Your act has gotten stale.
You're still welcome to dine with us, of course. We've just had quite enough of paying you to play our games.
